instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Take the next job another of my AIs left for me, so no other AI does it too", and give it as (The taking AI's record id).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:take-an-ai-job and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Without `id`, reads the ai-job records a take may move (read-data/ai-work.json: waiting ones for any AI or for `as`, and taken ones held longer than the stale-take time), sorts them by take_order (priority, then oldest first), and takes the first: one write of the whole job as taken by `as` at this time, conditioned on the value it read.
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: ai-job (records:read, records:list, records:write).
